lede: Two stories surfaced across more than one feed today. The death of Jeffrey Archer, the British novelist and former politician, at 86, drove searches in Germany and India and pushed his Wikipedia page onto the most-read list. Separately, a report that Anthropic flagged a Florida woman's Claude diary entry to police, leading to a felony charge, drew attention on both Hacker News and Lemmy. The day's largest single number came from elsewhere: Christa Pike topped Wikipedia's most-read pages with 333,405 views, a spike no other feed accounts for.

throughlines.gist: A new end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps took the top of GitHub trending with 1,398 stars in a day.
